brand.label: About Raydan
brand.heading: A cafeteria with the soul of a restaurant
brand.p1: Raydan blends the ease of a modern cafeteria with the atmosphere of a good restaurant. Guests choose their dishes at the serving line, and our team plates them quickly, neatly and with genuine warmth.
brand.p2: Tajik plov is the heart of the menu, joined by homemade dishes, soups, salads, Indian cuisine, desserts, coffee and signature drinks.

values.title: Homemade taste
values.text: Familiar comfort dishes, freshly cooked every single day.

values.title: Fast service
values.text: No waiting at the serving line — choose your dishes and take a seat.

values.title: International cuisine
values.text: From Tajik plov to Indian curries and signature drinks.

values.title: Warm hospitality
values.text: A team that welcomes every guest with genuine care.

signature.label: Signature dish
signature.heading: Plov worth coming back for
signature.sub: Plov and biryani are cooked daily and served straight from the line while they are truly fresh.

delivery.heading: Your favourite Raydan dishes, delivered
delivery.text: Order plov, hot dishes, salads, drinks and meals for a group. Call us to check availability and place your order.

catering.label: Catering
catering.heading: Catering and made-to-order dishes
catering.text: We cater business meetings, family celebrations, openings and large gatherings. We will help you choose dishes from the Raydan menu and have the order ready right on time.
